chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Jameel ibn Darraj, from Zarara, from one of the Imams (peace be upon them) who said:

Indeed, Allah, Mighty and Majestic, created the earth, then sent upon it salty water for forty mornings, and sweet water for forty mornings, until they met and mixed. Then He took a handful with His hand and rubbed it with a strong rubbing all together, then separated it into two parts. So from each one of them came out a neck (or particle) like the neck (or particle) of a gnat. So He took a neck to Paradise and a neck to the Fire.
ai.seo_question: What is the Shia hadith about the creation of the earth and the separation of waters into Paradise and Hell?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the cosmological mechanism of separating the primordial waters, a key element in Shia interpretations of the earth resting upon the whale. The imagery of the 'neck' (unq) emerging from each mixture symbolizes the distinct origins of the realms of bliss and punishment, reflecting the divine wisdom in structuring the universe's layers. This account complements the broader Shia discourse on the physical and metaphysical foundations of creation as described in the Quran and Hadith.

en.hubeali: H 14504 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraaj, from Zarara has narrated the following: One of themasws (Fifth or Sixth Imamasws) having said: ‘

Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Created the earth, then Sent to it the salty water for forty mornings, and the sweet water for forty mornings until they met and got mixed. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Took by His<sup>azwj</sup> Hand a handful and Stirred it intensely together, then Separated it into two separations. So from each one of these two came out particles like the particles of powder. So He<sup>azwj</sup> Took a (group of) particles to the Paradise, and a (group of) particles to the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 56. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraaj, from Zarara has narrated the following: One of them (a.s.) (Fifth or Sixth Imam (a.s.)) having said:

‘Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic Created the earth, then Sent to it the salty water for forty mornings, and the sweet water for forty mornings until they met and got mixed. Then He (azwj) Took by His (azwj) Hand a handful and Stirred it intensely together, then Separated it into two separations. So from each one of these two came out particles like the particles of powder. So He (azwj) Took a (group of) particles to the Paradise, and a (group of) particles to the Fire’.
